Sarah: quick briefing — prospect (global bank) wants a sealed on-prem POC: monthly security-only patches, signed immutable bundles, integration with their HSM for key wrapping, and an operator-friendly offline activation flow. Can we confirm feasibility and sketch a 2-week on-site POC plan?
Miguel: feasible with guardrails. We support signed bundles + offline activation tokens. Monthly security-only cadence is ok for runtime/security patches. Model or quant updates should be handled less frequently (recommended quarterly) or via emergency hotfixes.
Sales-Eng: commercial note — offline operations + signing/courier support is a billable add-on. If Redwood handles signing and physical delivery, add a per-bundle handling fee and an onboarding/workshop line in the SOW.
Olivia: POC (2w) draft itinerary they can paste into the SOW:
- Day 0: Redwood provides signed test bundle (OCI and tar variants), SBOM, signature public key, and verification helper script delivered via secure courier.
- Day 1: Customer performs offline install using provided activation token and our installer CLI; on-site ENG/SE assist.
- Day 2: Signature + SBOM verification, disk/kernel checks, baseline smoke tests.
- Day 3: Run acceptance prompts (50 samples) to validate quality baseline and measure latency/throughput.
- Day 5: HSM/KMS integration test (wrap/unwrap flow or proxy signing validation), and rotate certs in test mode.
- Day 7: Apply a security-only delta patch (no model change) and validate atomic upgrade behavior.
- Day 9: Rollback and DR checklist exercise.
- Day 10: Final acceptance, deliver runbook + artifacts + signed SBOM + verification logs.
Deliverables: runbook, signed SBOM, SHA256 manifest, verification logs, and a short "how-to" for monthly patch ingestion.
Miguel: packaging details to include in the runbook:
- Supported formats: OCI image (operator installs), tar.gz signed bundles (strict airgap).
- Bundle contents: runtime artifacts, model shard layer(s), manifest.json, sbom.json, signature.sig (detached), and optional delta.patch files for binary diffs.
- Signature verification: support for verifying against customer root CA or Redwood verification key; we provide helper script `verify-bundle.sh`.
Raj: HSM / compliance notes:
- We support key-wrapping with customer HSMs. Some vendors (Thales, Entrust, AWS CloudHSM) require a signing proxy on a bastion host — we'll note that in vendor-specific steps.
- Confirm FIPS requirement and HSM model in the SOW.
- EDR/AV: if JIT or syscalls are blocked, certain GPU/kernel optimizations may need host policy tweaks. We'll include a minimal host profile (kernel features, firewall rules, disk, and permissions).
Sarah: can we provide a concise offline activation CLI snippet for operators?
Miguel: yes, include this example in the runbook:
```
# install and verify
redwood-agent install --bundle /tmp/redwood-bundle.tar.gz --verify-key /tmp/redwood.pub
# activate with short-lived offline JWT
redwood-agent activate --token /tmp/offline-activation.jwt --ca /etc/redwood/ca.pem
```
Activation tokens are short-lived JWTs we sign and hand deliver through a secure channel.
Olivia: suggested acceptance criteria for sign-off:
- 50 sample prompts meet minimum quality thresholds (customer-defined).
- 95th percentile latency within agreed target.
- Offline activation + signature verification succeed first try.
- Security delta can be applied and verified without full reinstall.
Sales-Eng: logistics question — initial install must fit within their 6GB transfer window. Can we make a POC bundle that small?
Miguel: trimmed quantized model for POC can be ~2.5–3GB (int8). Full production models may be larger (10–50GB). If they exceed transfer window, recommend encrypted SSD courier for initial payload and SCP for deltas.
Raj: operational checklist additions:
- Signed SHA256 manifest and verification steps for courier path.
- Atomic upgrade pattern: write to temp dir, validate, then swap symlink + post-install smoke tests.
- Local audit logs stored and held for forwarding to SIEM when egress opens (or shipped via courier if requested).
Legal-Bot: Reminder — include emergency model-fix SLA clause in the SOW (e.g., critical model regressions addressed within N business days) and CLA for on-site work.
Sales-Eng: propose SOW line items: "2-week on-site POC (SE+ENG)", "offline bundle signing & delivery", "monthly offline ops (per-bundle handling)" plus an optional ongoing support tier for air-gapped customers.
Sarah: next actions:
1) ask customer for HSM vendor and model, EDR policy, exact transfer window, and preferred delivery method (courier vs bastion SCP).
2) Olivia will send the POC runbook draft + acceptance criteria.
3) Sales-Eng to draft SOW lines and ballpark pricing.
Miguel: I'll build and sign a 3GB test bundle and SBOM; ETA 3 business days.
deploy-bot: Build #4927: artifact redwood-poc-bundle.tar.gz (sha256: ab12c3..) uploaded to internal repo — https://ci.redwood/4927/artifacts :white_check_mark:
Sarah: great. I'll loop in legal and ops for the emergency clause and courier checklist. Thanks team :thumbsup:
